description.value: The study examined how a self-efficacy strategy modulates neural correlates of cue-induced craving and craving regulation in male smokers and ex-smokers using fMRI.

spans.text: The main aim of our study was to investigate how the strategy focusing on cessation self-efficacy impacts the neural correlates of cue-induced craving and those of craving regulation in smokers and ex-smokers.
